_meanings:
²1 To remain, stay, abide; {#tena saha suKamavatizWante#} <ls>K. 108</ls>;
 <ab>oft.</ab> with an <ab>adj.</ab>; {#vilokayantI tAvadavatasTe#} <ls n="K.">205</ls>; {#pAdO vizwaBya#};
 {#kzaRaM BadrAvatizWasva#} <ls>Bk. 8. 11</ls> stay, wait; {#anItvA paNkatAM DUlimudakaM#}
 {#nAvatizWate#} <ls>Śi. 2. 34</ls>.
.²2 To abide by, conform to, obey; {#na SAsane'vAsTita yo gurURAm#} <ls>Bk. 3. 14</ls>.
.²3 To live; {#kzaRamapyavatizWate Svasan yadi janturnanu lABavAnasO#} <ls>R. 8. 87</ls>.
.²4 To stand (still), make a halt, stop; {#na ca SaknomyavasTAtum#} <ls>Bg. 1. 30</ls>, <ls n="Bg.">14. 23</ls>;
 <ls>R. 2. 31</ls>; <ls>Ku. 3. 42</ls>; <ls>Śi. 9. 83</ls>.
.²5 To stand, exist, chance to be.
.²6 To fall to, devolve on.
.²7 To enter; reach, attain to.
.²8 To stand apart, go off, withdraw.
.²9 To descend; go to.
.²10 To place (<ab>Ved.</ab>).

.²1 To cause to stand
 or stop, station, keep, place; {#paScAdavasTApitavAhinIkaH#} <ls>R. 13. 66</ls>;
 {#skanDAvAramavasTApya#} <ls>Dk. 174</ls> having encamped; {#BikzApAtraM nAgadantake'vasTApya#} <ls>H. 1</ls>, <ls n="H.">3</ls>.
.²2 To fix, settle; {#Sakyo'vasTApayitum#} <ls>Mu. 1</ls>.
.²3 To establish, found; {#dvErAjyamavasTApayitukAmo'smi#} <ls>M. 5</ls>.
.²4 To compose, collect, steady, fix (as heart <ab>&c.</ab>); {#na Sakomi hfdayamavasTApayitum#} <ls>U. 4</ls>.
.²5 To comfort, console; {#tato niryAya kOravya avasTApya ca tadbalam#} <ls>Mb. 3. 16. 29</ls>.
.²6 To separate, divide.
